data.title: Govt's poverty test under fire
data.description: For 77-year-old Wimol Suanngam, the state welfare card is more than a monthly benefit. It represents a small measure of security in a life marked by hardship, disability and isolation.

data.title: Balancing act on Myanmar
data.description: Thailand is walking a diplomatic tightrope as it seeks to facilitate efforts to address the Myanmar crisis. On July 12-13, Thailand hosted informal Asean meetings in Bangkok and Pattaya, bringing together Asean foreign ministers, Myanmar's foreign minister, the National Solidarity and Peacemaking Negotiation Committee (NSPNC) and six ethnic armed organisations (EAOs).

data.title: Southern springboard to growth
data.description: Phangnga is transforming itself from a seasonal beach destination into a fast-growing premium tourism market, supported by strong visitor spending, niche attractions and growing investor confidence.

data.title: Moving beyond tech dependency
data.description: Thailand's ambition to become a regional digital hub has raised a central policy question: whether to prioritise expanding public access to artificial intelligence or build the foundations to develop it.

data.title: The neighbourhood is the key to a better Bangkok
data.description: A 'Voice from Bangkok' talk has suggested that more localised improvements may be what is needed for city-wide change.

data.title: Parents debate curbing kids' social media time
data.description: As policymakers debate whether Thailand should follow countries such as Australia and the United Kingdom in restricting children's access to social media, many parents say the real battle is already taking place inside their homes.

data.title: Experts weigh in on Mukdahan crash
data.description: The car accident in Mukdahan that resulted in the deaths of 10 monks highlights critical questions about child protection, parental responsibility and road safety.

data.title: Calls for Isoc reform mount
data.description: The Internal Security Operations Command (Isoc) remains necessary to tackle complex threats, but the agency must modernise, improve transparency and reduce spending, security experts say.

data.title: Govt plans to cut civil service
data.description: The government's proposal to encourage civil servants as young as 40 years old to leave the bureaucracy voluntarily could become one of the most ambitious efforts in years to reduce the size of the state workforce.
